newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-GRASSHOPPER ZURICH V AUXERRE TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRASSHOPPER ZURICH V AUXERRE TEAMS.

Auxerre: 1-Lionel Charbonnier, 2-Alain Goma, 6-Philippe Violeau, 8-Moussa Saib, 10-Antoine Sibierski, 11-Bernard Diomede, 12-Taribo West, 13-Frederic Danjou, 14-Christian Henna, 17-Steve Marlet, 22-Eric Assati.
